italian-reading-12.title: Let's read
italian-reading-12.subtitle: Read familiar patterns in context
italian-reading-12.description: Read familiar patterns in words and sentences, not only in isolation.

ir12-p1.translations: It is Sunday. Giulia and her son go out in the city.

ir12-p2.translations: At the market, the man asks, “How much does this book cost?”

ir12-p3.translations: Giulia chooses the peaches and buys some ice cream and a ball for her son.

ir12-p4.translations: In the evening she makes spaghetti with mushrooms. They are happy because they are together.

ir12-t1.text: Read familiar patterns in words and sentences, not only in isolation.

ir12-t2.text: Use context and vocabulary hints, then check your understanding with the questions.

ir12_q1.question: Which word contains the GLI combination?

ir12_q2.question: Which word contains the QU combination?

ir12_q3.question: Which word has a doubled consonant?

ir12_q4.question: Which word from the text contains QU?

ir12_q5.question: Which word from the text has a doubled consonant?
